desc: 吸管直饮一盖两用，双层真空锁温，细身进杯架，带提环好携带
name: 双饮盖真空保温运动水瓶款

shots.intent: 建立形态记忆：细长瓶身加双饮盖与提环
把双层真空可视化为材料与工艺证据
一口两喝的工程证明：吸管口与直饮口同框标注
便携证据：提环拱形受光成画
消除放不进杯架的顾虑：中控杯架实拍
说走就走的装备伙伴情绪：蓝天高对比下的行进感
系列感与色选：统一机位的多色瓶阵列
套装价值感：买一瓶得全套的诚意收束
到手确定性收口：瓶与包装盒并排加实测尺寸

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, macros and lineup; high-key sky #9DC0E4 with concrete #B4B8BC for the structure proof; real environments for scenes - dark car interior #33383D, blue-sky highland #85AFDC; every captioned frame carries the black #0A0A0B bottom banner
style.direction: performance-hydration gear suite: white studio proof system plus real daylight scene system, black caption bar as the typographic signature
style.iconSystem: 1.5px thin-line single-color icon inside a thin circle at the left end of the caption bar, one icon per frame matching the claim
style.lightingSystem: large top-left softbox with faint contact shadow for studio; natural hard midday sun outdoors with the sky as the key that rims the dark bottle; close diffuse for macros
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: performance-hydration e-commerce suite. Matte powder-coated steel bottle in deep charcoal #1E2126 (forest green #2E4A3A alternate) on seamless white #FFFFFF under a large top-left softbox with faint contact shadow; proof shots use high-key sky #9DC0E4 with brushed-steel #C9CDD1 inner-wall detail; scene shots use real daylight environments - dark car interior #33383D or blue-sky highland #85AFDC - with a black #0A0A0B bottom banner carrying one bold white claim, a white pill tag and a thin-line circle icon. One claim per frame, product always tack sharp, generic faceless persons only, colorways confined to variant frames, no logos, no kids prints, no second accent family.
noDrift: no second accent family beyond the palette
no brand logos, vehicle badges or screen UI
no caption text copied from the source
no studio-set hybrid backgrounds in scene frames
gradient colorways never dilute the hero's matte black-silver mood
style.presentationRules: one claim per frame; product always tack sharp at 12-50% occupancy, copy never sits on the product surface; models are generic faceless persons shown by torso and limbs only; colorways appear only in variant frames; light colorways staged against dark environments for contrast
style.surfaceSystem: matte powder-coated steel with fine grain, matte plastic lid, brushed stainless inner wall in cutaway views; environments stay matte (fabric seat, concrete, rock) with no mirror reflections
style.temperature: neutral-cool whites and steel; real scenes balance with natural warm sun
style.typography: bold geometric sans-serif; white claim on the black banner plus a white pill tag, dark charcoal on white grounds; annotations are thin leader lines with dot terminals and very short words
